summary.answer: Initializes six controller progress/status models only when absent, then creates dynent/heal/revive/being-revived/bleedout progress and text/prompt children. Healing requires powerRatio>0, ability in-use and player not dead; Reviving uses reviveProgress>0, BeingRevived equality1, CowardsWayOut exact setting plus last-stand/not-ended/not-finished guards, Deposit both dynent progress and depositing>0. Ratio updates write the exact shader data; reviveProgress callback delegates smooth interpolation only for nonnil values. All status changes request state reevaluation. Close registration/postload precede SetupReviveProgressBar and SetupBleedoutProgressBar, then self return. This consumes combat state and does not implement revive/deposit timing or native cancellation.
